metadata.title: SecureEWS: Capacity-aware evaluation of data-minimized educational early-warning systems
metadata.description: Code, frozen protocols, aggregate results, paired-bootstrap draws, verification reports, and manuscript materials for evaluating data-minimized educational early-warning systems as educator decision-support tools across review capacities and educational stages. The release supports institutional assessment of review-list usefulness, data scope, residual attribute predictability, and reproducibility. Raw or processed row-level data, individual predictions, trained models, private clean-room payloads, and XuetangX files are not included. Code: MIT; documentation and aggregate research materials: CC BY 4.0.
